tutorial.text: We have to do the test over and over. For this, we use the "always-if" construction.
Lawn sprouts can be separated from weeds using a vertical line.
The position of the vertical line is set by the x coordinate. The weeds are to the right of the line, hence the "greater than" sign.
You can set any number from 60 to 120 as a border. But 120 will not work because 120 is not greater than 120.
